conflicts.resolution: Extract orthographic-enough frames from the original footage and accept a named configuration before final modeling.

conflicts.finding: 9K38 Igla, Igla-S/9K338, and training/visual-simulator imagery are mixed in public records.

conflicts.finding: Colt sheet prints 14.5 in and 386 mm together; the exact conversion is 368.3 mm.
conflicts.resolution: Use the stated inch dimension and computed conversion until Colt publishes a corrected metric value.
